title.narrative: Lebanese Elections Assistance and Parliamentary Support

description.narrative: In December 2022, UNDP received an official request from the Ministry of Interior and Municipalities for electoral assistance for the period 2024 – 2027, covering the 2024 municipal and 2027 parliamentary elections. Consequently, in June 2023, the UN deployed a Needs Assessment Mission (NAM) in order to assess the electoral environment and identify the opportunities of having a new electoral assistance cycle.
